newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell slightly to 2.916 billion yuan from 3.101 billion with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.

Trading volume was large despite a slight fall because Wednesday was the monthly settlement day for April for financial institutions, which pushed both demand and supply up on the market, traders said.
The recent bull run on the domestic A share markets was another reason for heavy turnover with securities houses borrowing heavily on the interbank market, traders said.

Traders said they expected trading to calm down a little after the holiday. The interbank market will be closed from Thursday to Saturday due to the Labor Holiday and trading will resume on Sunday, May 4.
